---
title: "Recruitment to another trial"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

- The export has no recruitment date, so recruitment is not restricted to a follow-up window.
- Added: logistic regression on randomized group, unadjusted, for the probabilities, their difference (ctDNA − Usual care) and the odds ratio.

```{r}
#| label: setup

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(brms)
library(marginaleffects)
library(knitr)
library(yaml)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "13-other-trial", "results")
models_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "models")
dir.create(models_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_path <- file.path(models_dir, "recruitment.rds")

cohort <- read_parquet(
  here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet")
)
```

## Model fit

```{r}
#| label: fit

model_data <- cohort |>
  select(other_trial_recruited, tx) |>
  as.data.frame()

if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  fit <- brm(
    other_trial_recruited ~ tx,
    data = model_data,
    family = bernoulli("logit"),
    iter = 2000L,
    chains = 4L,
    cores = 1L,
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = config$seeds$supporting + 7000L,
    refresh = 0L
  )
  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}

fit <- readRDS(model_path)
fit <- set_modeldata(fit, fit$data)

summary(fit)
```

## Patients recruited by randomized group

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-summary

probability_draws <- avg_predictions(fit, by = "tx", type = "response") |>
  get_draws() |>
  select(tx, drawid, draw)

recruitment_summary <- model_data |>
  summarise(
    patients = n(),
    recruited = sum(other_trial_recruited),
    .by = tx
  ) |>
  left_join(
    probability_draws |>
      summarise(
        posterior_median = median(draw),
        lower_95 = quantile(draw, 0.025),
        upper_95 = quantile(draw, 0.975),
        .by = tx
      ),
    by = "tx"
  ) |>
  mutate(proportion = recruited / patients, .after = recruited) |>
  arrange(desc(tx))

write_parquet(
  recruitment_summary,
  file.path(results_dir, "recruitment-summary.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

recruitment_summary |>
  mutate(group = group_factor(tx), .before = 1) |>
  select(-tx) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```

## Difference and odds ratio

```{r}
#| label: recruitment-difference

difference_draws <- probability_draws |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = tx, values_from = draw, names_prefix = "tx_") |>
  mutate(difference = tx_1 - tx_0) |>
  pull(difference)

odds_ratio_draws <- exp(as_draws_df(fit)$b_tx)

recruitment_difference <- tibble(
  difference_median = median(difference_draws),
  difference_low = quantile(difference_draws, 0.025, names = FALSE),
  difference_high = quantile(difference_draws, 0.975, names = FALSE),
  prob_higher_ctdna = mean(difference_draws > 0),
  odds_ratio_median = median(odds_ratio_draws),
  odds_ratio_low = quantile(odds_ratio_draws, 0.025, names = FALSE),
  odds_ratio_high = quantile(odds_ratio_draws, 0.975, names = FALSE)
)

write_parquet(
  recruitment_difference,
  file.path(results_dir, "recruitment-difference.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

dir.create(file.path(results_dir, "figures"), showWarnings = FALSE)
save_figure(
  plot_posterior(
    100 * difference_draws,
    "Difference in recruitment to another trial (ctDNA − usual care), percentage points"
  ),
  file.path(results_dir, "figures", "recruitment-difference-posterior.png")
)

kable(recruitment_difference, digits = 3)
```
